description:
About PHIL

Getting a prescription filled shouldn't be the hardest part of starting treatment. Yet for many patients, it is. PHIL is a Series D health-tech company building the platform that connects patients, prescribers, pharmacies, and pharmaceutical manufacturers so patients can get their medication quickly and affordably.

Our digital hub and pharmacy platform handles everything from enrollment and benefits verification to prior authorization, copay support, and home delivery. For manufacturers, that means more patients start therapy and stay on it, plus the commercial insight to keep improving access.

We're a diverse team of people from a wide range of backgrounds, united by a focus on the patient experience.

The role

We're hiring a Workflow Automation Specialist to remove manual work from our pharmacy network and patient fulfillment operations through practical automation and AI workflows. This is an individual contributor, hands-on operations role, not a custom-engineering or research role. Faster, cleaner operations let us serve more patients as we grow.

You'll report to the VP of Operations and work closely with our frontline pharmacy intake, customer care, and fulfillment teams, and with Engineering. You'll lead the discovery and build the solutions alongside operations, while Engineering supports on security, compliance, and handoffs.

What you'll own

  • Workflow discovery: Shadow pharmacy intake, customer care, and fulfillment teams, then map current processes and leaner future-state versions.

  • Automations and AI workflows: Build with Make, Zapier, n8n, or Power Automate plus LLM APIs for document triage, data validation, status updates, and ticket resolution, favoring simple, maintainable fixes and flagging what to redesign or eliminate instead.

  • Engineering partnership: Work with Engineering on secure API access, data integrity, and compliance, and hand off automations that become core product infrastructure.

  • Measurement and guardrails: Set KPIs upfront (cycle time, touchpoints per order, error rate, hours saved), monitor error logs and AI output accuracy, and keep platform costs in check.

  • Adoption and reuse: Write documentation, train operations staff, gather feedback, and package proven automations and prompt templates for other teams.

What success looks like in your first year

  • By 90 days: You've shadowed the pharmacy intake, customer care, and fulfillment teams, mapped their current workflows, and shipped a first automation with agreed KPIs.

  • By 6 months: Several of your automations are live and in daily use, with documentation, trained users, and tracked results on cycle time, error rate, and hours saved.

  • By 12 months: Operations teams beyond your first partners use your reusable automation patterns and prompt templates, and your KPIs show a measurable drop in manual touchpoints and errors.

What you'll bring

Our strongest candidates have worked alongside operations teams and built live automations, so they understand how frontline work gets done and what makes a tool stick. They come from process automation, business systems analysis, or operations engineering, and they enjoy listening to non-technical teammates describe their daily pain points.

  • 3-6 years of experience in business process automation, operational excellence, business systems analysis, or operations engineering

  • Hands-on experience building and maintaining live automations in a workflow platform (Make, Zapier, n8n, Workato, or Power Automate), using REST APIs and webhooks

  • Practical experience using AI in production workflows, such as LLM prompt engineering, agents, structured document extraction, or automated classification and summarization

  • Experience running process discovery with operational stakeholders and producing clear process maps and SOPs

  • Clear communication with frontline support staff, clinical coordinators, and software engineers alike

  • You default to action: you prototype quickly, handle edge cases, and ship working solutions over perfect ones

Nice to have

  • Light scripting in Python or JavaScript/Node.js for custom API payloads or data transformations when low-code tools hit their limits

  • Experience with data hygiene, prompt evaluation, and monitoring for autonomous agent loops

  • Background in healthcare operations, pharmacy fulfillment, or patient-support services, and familiarity with HIPAA

Why PHIL

At PHIL, we're tackling one of healthcare's most persistent challenges: helping patients access the medications they need without unnecessary delays, complexity, or financial barriers.

As a growing Series D healthcare technology company, we're building solutions that connect patients, prescribers, pharmacies, and pharmaceutical manufacturers to improve the prescription experience.

This is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact at a pivotal stage of our growth, helping shape solutions that improve patient access and support PHIL's continued expansion.

Benefits at a glance

  • Fully remote working environment available in the following states: AZ, CA, CO, FL, GA, IA, ID, IL, IN, MA, MI, MO, NC, NH, NJ, NY, OH, OK, OR, PA, SC, TN, TX, UT, VA, WA, WI, WV

  • Full benefits (medical, dental, vision)

  • 401(k) contribution opportunity

  • Paid Parental Leave

  • Fertility Benefit

PHIL is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and don't discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.
